Description (in game): Applying attack spells to multiple targets does not reduce the damage inflicted, but does cause them to target the user.
Notes: Removes group cast penalty from offensive spells. When using healing spells on undead, there is no group cast penalty against those undead and the healing spell will also target yourself, however the healing on non-undead enemies and yourself will still be subject to group cast penalties.

Description (in game): Attack spells are 20% more powerful, and also reduce their targets' MP. However, they will also occasionally target all allies and enemies.
Notes: MP drain is 1.5% for all targets hit, excludes self. NOT affected by luck but is affected by Results Guaranteed.

Description (in game): Strike all enemies with a powerful darkness-imbued magical attack.
Notes: Condition: Use Necromancy x13. Res Pow +30%.

Description (in game): Perform a dark magic attack on a target/all targets.
Perform a magical attack on ally and foe alike that combines the powers of fire and water.
Perform a magic attack that absorbs a target's HP.
Notes: Restores HP equal to 100% of damage dealt

Description (in game): Perform a powerful dark magic attack on a target/all targets.
Perform a magical attack on ally and foe alike that combines the powers of lightning and light.
Perform a magic attack that absorbs a target's MP.
Notes: Deals MP damage, restore MP equal to 100% of damage dealt. Seems to cap at ~170 MP damage dealt, before random damage factor

Description (in game): Perform an extremely powerful dark magic attack on a target/all targets.
Perform a powerful magical attack on ally and foe alike that combines the powers of fire and wind.
Attempt to instantly KO a target.
MP is restored by 5% at the end of each turn.
Perform two to four quick non-elemental magic attacks on a target.
Notes: Exact damage of each hit varies, in order: 1.35 + 1.4 + 1.3 + 1.45. Average damage ratio of 4.1

Description (in game): Perform an incredibly powerful dark magic attack on a target.
Spells cost 50% more MP, but deal 25% more damage.
Perform an extremely powerful magical attack on ally and foe alike that combines the powers of earth and darkness.
Perform four incredibly powerful non-elemental magic attacks on random enemies in quick succession.
Notes: Total damage ratio of 16x

Description (in game): When Defaulting, damage received is further reduced at a cost of 15 MP. The MP cost is incurred even if the damage is nullified by immunity or absorbed.
Notes: Damage reduction only triggers if MP price can be paid. If MP is below 15, Default Gaurd will not activate. Only triggers on genuine Defaults, automatic Defaulting from e.g. Auto Guard, Protect Ally etc. will not trggier Default Guard.

Description (in game): When Defaulting, one BP will be earned when attacked, at a cost of 15 MP.
Notes: BP generation only triggers if MP price can be paid. If MP is between 15-29, Default Guard takes priority to activate over Fortitude. Only triggers on genuine Defaults, automatic Defaulting from e.g. Auto Guard, Protect Ally etc. will not trggier Fortitude.

Description (in game): Strike all enemies with a powerful light-imbued magical attack and erect a barrier that will protect all allies from a single physical or magical attack. Cannot be combined with Rampart or Vallation.
Notes: Condition: Use Default x13. Speed +20%. Note that this does indeed deal magic damage, not physical.

Description (in game): Perform a quick physical attack on a target and increase the user's physical defence by 15% for three turns. Stats cannot be increased beyond 200% of their base value.
Perform a quick physical attack on a target and increase the user's magical defence by 15% for three turns. Stats cannot be increased beyond 200% of their base value.
Erect a barrier that will protect multiple targets from a single physical attack. Cannot be combined with Vallation.
Notes: Barrier is active on each character separately, so every character can absorb a single physical attack. Only prevents damage, not other effects of attacks (e.g. status ailments)

Description (in game): Erect a barrier that will protect multiple targets from a single magical attack. Cannot be combined with Rampart.
Notes: Barrier is active on each character separately, so every character can absorb a single magic attack. Only prevents damage, not other effects of attacks (e.g. status ailments)

Description (in game): Perform a powerful light-imbued physical attack on a target.
Increase the user's physical and magical defence by 25% for three turns. Stats cannot be increased beyond 200% of their base value.
Perform a physical attack that's extremely effective on blinded targets.
Notes: Damage ratio becomes 6x when striking blind foes (6x normal damage)

Description (in game): The user's turn will come around more slowly, but they will Default automatically even when it is not their turn.
Notes: Does not count as defaulting for the purpose of abilities, such as Default Guard or Fortitude

Description (in game): Performing a critical attack may cause BP to increase by one.
Notes: NOT affected by Luck, for some reason.

Description (in game): For three turns, Defaulting will increase BP by two instead of one.
Notes: Only counts genuine defaults. Automatic defaults such as through Auto Guard, Protect Ally and similar are not counted.

Description (in game): Shut up shop so that allied and enemy HP, MP and BP cannot be changed until the user's next turn. (However, usage costs for any abilities used in the meantime will still be deducted.)
Notes: Prevents damage and healing.

Description (in game): Increases BP limit by one, allowing up to four BP to be accumulated.
Perform an extremely powerful light-imbued physical attack on a target.
Notes: Unlike Light of Justice, Holy Light doesn't use your weapon(s) type.

Description (in game): Shield aptitude is increased to S.
Perform a powerful physical attack on a target that will deal more damage the higher the user's physical defence.
Notes: Uses P.Atk + P.Def as Attack in damage formula

Description (in game): Any physical or magical attack that successfully exploits an enemy's weakness has a 50% chance of inflicting critical damage.
Notes: Not affected by luck. It has a 50% chance to activate and guarantees criticals when it does, as opposed to giving +50% crit chance.

Description (in game): Expends 40 MP to guarantee that any ability effect with a percentage chance of occurring will be triggered.
Notes: Affects almost everything with a chance of activating including passives and abilities. This includes everything affected by luck, except steal chance, plus status ailments, Achilles' Heel and Critical Flow. Also does not affect critical chance or weapon additional status ailments (other sources of status ailments are guaranteed however).

Description (in game): Strike a single enemy with a powerful physical attack.
Notes: Condition: Use Attack/Occultism x13. Evasion +15%, Crit +15%.

Description (in game): Perform a single quick physical attack on a target. If the target is defeated, another action can be performed.
Notes: If target dies, remainder of users actions are cancelled, and their turn starts again. This counts as an additional turn for the purpose of buffs/debuffs, and if you have negative BP at the start of the turn it will simply recover 1 BP.

Description (in game): Increase the user's physical and magical attack by 25% for three turns. Stats cannot be increased beyond 200% of their base value.
Perform three quick physical attacks on a target.
Notes: Total damage ratio is 4x

Description (in game): Perform a powerful darkness-imbued physical attack on a target.
Perform a physical attack that's extremely effective against poisoned targets.
Notes: Damage ratio becomes 6x when striking poisoned foes (6x normal damage)

Description (in game): Critical hit damage is increased by 30%.
Notes: Damage bonus is added directly to critical multiplier, raising it to 1.8x (if using multiple copies through Vengeance, becomes 2.1x then 2.4x)

Description (in game): Enable the user to evade a single physical attack.
Perform a physical attack that's extremely effective against targets suffering from contagion.
Notes: Damage ratio becomes 6x when striking foes suffering from contagion (6x normal damage)

Description (in game): Evading an attack will cause BP to increase by one.
Notes: Triggers even if the attack was self targeted, and regardless of how the evasion activated (e.g. Counter Savvy will activate Turn Tables)

Description (in game): Inflicting a status ailment on a target will be rewarded with an extra action.
Notes: Extra action means another turn. See Recurring Nightmare for description of how the "extra action" effect works. Interestingly, this triggers when hitting an enemy with Salve Maker's Analysis despite it not inflicting a status ailment. Does not activate if you already have a different Analysis active however, nor does it activate if inflicting a 2nd elemental debuff on a foe that already has one.

Description (in game): Equipping multiple weapons will not reduce their effectiveness.
Notes: Without Dual Wield, your P.Atk, M.Atk, Res Pow, Aim and Crit are multiplied by 0.585 when equipping two weapons. With Dual Wield, only your Aim and Crit are multiplied by 0.585, i.e. your P.Atk, M.Atk and Res Pow suffer no reduction.

Description (in game): Perform an extremely powerful physical attack on a target. If the target is defeated, another action can be performed.
Notes: See Recurring Nightmare for description of what happens when this kills an enemy

Description (in game): Perform an extremely powerful darkness-imbued physical attack on a target.
The maximum number of hits dealt by the 'Attack' command is increased from 16 to 32.
Notes: Hit count is only used for basic attacks. Each hit count increases damage by 5% of the base damage, and you gain 1 base hit count roughly every 5 levels (21 hit count at level 99)

Description (in game): Enable the user's weapon to ignore enemies' physical defence for three turns.
Notes: Doesn't affect magic. Despite description, weapon is not related to the effect - you can switch weapons or even be unequipped and continue to benefit.

Description (in game): 8% of HP and MP are restored at the end of each turn, but being knocked out will reduce BP to -3.
Taking damage equal to [or] more than 25% of max. HP will cause attack and defence to be increased by 10% for three turns.
Notes: Buff cannot be removed by Purge or similar, for some reason. Seems limited to triggering once per turn.

Description (in game): Strike all enemies with a powerful non-elemental magical attack.
Notes: Condition: Use Diabolism x13. P.Atk +15%. This is indeed magic damage as stated in the description - Hellblade has excellent M.Atk as well as P.Atk.

Description (in game): Expend 25% of the user's max. HP in order to perform three powerful fire-imbued physical attacks on a target at regular intervals.
Notes: Damage is dealt 3 times, each treated as if it were another attack from the user with its own independent chance of hitting and critting. Buffs they currently have active will be factored in to the damage, therefore if used shortly before buffs wear off the 2nd and 3rd hits deal less damage. These attacks will trigger most skills. Critical Flow and some others will not trigger. Up to 3 blades can be active on a target at once, after which the oldest will be overwritten. Action cost numbers show your cooldown (setting) and the cooldown between each blade hit (recurring).

Description (in game): Expend 25% of the user's max. HP in order to perform three powerful water-imbued physical attacks on a target at regular intervals.
Notes: See Ruby Blades description for details

Description (in game): Attempt to fill a target with dread.
Expend 25% of the user's max. HP in order to perform three powerful lightning-imbued physical attacks on a target at regular intervals.
Notes: See Ruby Blades description for details

Description (in game): Inflict damage on a target equal to the user's max. HP minus their current HP.
Expend 25% of the user's max. HP in order to perform three powerful earth-imbued physical attacks on a target at regular intervals.
Notes: See Ruby Blades description for details

Description (in game): Expend 25% of the user's max. HP in order to perform three powerful wind-imbued physical attacks on a target at regular intervals.
Notes: See Ruby Blades description for details

Description (in game): Perform a physical attack that's extremely effective against targets suffering from dread.
Notes: Damage ratio becomes 6x when striking foes suffering from terror (6x normal damage)

Description (in game): Expend 25% of the user's max. HP in order to perform three extremely powerful light-imbued physical attacks on a target at regular intervals.
Notes: See Ruby Blades description for details

Description (in game): Expend 25% of the user's max. HP in order to perform three extremely powerful darkness-imbued physical attacks on a target at regular intervals.
Notes: See Ruby Blades description for details

Description (in game): The user is doomed. In exchange, attack and defence are increased by 50%. Stats cannot be increased beyond 200% of their base value.
Notes: Buff is linked to the doom status. If doom is prevented no stats are gained, if doom is removed the buffs are also removed. Has an odd interaction with Rewarding Results, you will get the P.Atk buff only, but it is not linked to your doom status.

Description (in game): The upper limit for the amount of damage that can be inflicted is increased so that it can exceed 9999.
Notes: Damage limit is increased to 99,999. Does not affect healing limit, or any other limits.

Description (in game): Sacrifice all MP in order to inflict damage on a target proportional to the amount of MP expended.
Notes: Damage dealt scales with units spent on cost. If cost is reduced (e.g. through MP Saver), damage dealt also drops. If HP/MP Converter is used, damage is increased proportionally. Physical damage scaling bonuses multiply damage, for example Hurts So Bad and Dirty Fighter.

Description (in game): Physical and magical attack power increase as HP is reduced.
Notes: Damage bonus scales based on absolute HP, not a % of max. Exact multiplier is 1 + 100/(HP + 99) to both P.Atk and M.Atk, rounded to the nearest 1%

Description (in game): Bombard all targets with ten magical sword strikes imbued with random elements, after which the user will be left with one HP, zero MP and -3 BP.
Notes: Cannot be used if braving. Every hit has a random element, so every enemy could be struck by a different element at once, and has its own independent chance of hitting. After use, leaves Deathstorm effect on enemy which behaves like Blades abilities (see Ruby Blades description for details) but with random elements. After use user's HP/MP/BP are dropped, but this occurs before any support skills heal them. If user is suffering Dread their BP will not drop. In spite of description this deals physical damage. If Sanctuary is used, no HP/MP/BP is lost.

Description (in game): Defeating a target increases BP by one.
Notes: Activates once per enemy killed if multiple are killed on the same turn.

Description (in game): BP increase by one at the start of each turn.
Notes: Activates even when taking an additional turn, through e.g. Rewarding Results

Description (in game): Strike a single enemy with a powerful physical attack and increase all allies' BP by one.
Notes: Condition: Use Bravery x13. P.Atk +30%, M.Atk +30%.

Description (in game): Deal damage to all targets equal to 25% of the user's current HP.
Notes: Fixed damage not affected by group scaling, but affected by physical damage modifications.

Description (in game): Cause all allies and enemies to lose one BP three times at regular intervals.
Notes: Activation frequency based on user's turn delays. Recurring value shows frequency of BP drop

Description (in game): Sword aptitude is increased to S.
Deal physical damage to a target based on the length of time for which the game has been played.
Notes: Damage dealt = number of minutes played. Fixed damage, not affected by group scaling.

Description (in game): Cause all allies and enemies to gain one BP three times at regular intervals.
Notes: Activation frequency based on user's turn delays. Recurring value shows frequency of BP drop

Description (in game): Deal damage to all targets equal to 50% of the user's current HP.
Notes: Fixed damage not affected by group scaling, but affected by physical damage modifications.

Description (in game): Reduce BP by one for all allies and enemies whose BP is at one or more, and increase it by one for anyone whose BP is at minus one or below.
Notes: Looks at BP when the ability activates, so if you e.g. start at 0 BP but brave to negative, Equaliser will give you BP.

Description (in game): Any enemy twenty or more levels below the user is instantly killed at the beginning of battle.
Notes: Inflicts instant death on affected enemies. Can only target some enemies in a battle, if the level gap is less than 20 for some enemies. Enemies immune to Death will not be affected, and counts as an ability use for the sake of triggering enemy counters.

Description (in game): Deal physical damage to a target based on the number of battles you've won.
Notes: Damage dealt = number of battles won x2. Fixed damage, not affected by group scaling. Chain battles count as a single win for the sake of this skill.

Description (in game): The second speciality listed for the user's sub-job is activated.
Notes: Specialties can only activate once, regardless of the number of ways they are activated (e.g. through Double Duty, SJS1/2 and the Spiritmaster/Bravebearer weapons)

Description (in game): Deal damage to all targets equal to 75% of the user's current HP.
Notes: Fixed damage not affected by group scaling, but affected by physical damage modifications.

Description (in game): Perform two physical attacks on a target, each dealing damage based on the number of battles you've won.
Notes: Damage dealt = number of battles won x3, twice. Fixed damage, not affected by group scaling. Chain battles count as a single win for the sake of this skill.

Description (in game): Any ability that usually affects a single target now affects multiple targets.
Notes: Almost all moves that normally can target a single person (foe, ally or either) are affected and have the option to target the entire team. Unless the attack deals fixed damage, group damage scaling will apply.

Description (in game): Increase all allies' BP by one.
Perform two physical attacks on a target, each dealing damage based on the length of time for which the game has been played.
Notes: Damage dealt = number of minutes played (twice). Fixed damage, not affected by group scaling.
